name: netft-viewer
description: Cross-platform desktop viewer for ATI Net F/T sensors.
author: Net F/T contributors

scripts.lint: tools/eslint/node_modules/.bin/eslint app test/electron test/e2e test/support/fake-companion.mjs test/project/*.test.mjs tools/*.mjs tools/lib/*.mjs forge.config.ts playwright.config.ts vite.main.config.ts vite.preload.config.ts vite.renderer.config.ts vitest.config.ts --config tools/eslint/eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings=0
scripts.format: prettier --write app test/electron test/e2e test/support/fake-companion.mjs test/project/*.test.mjs tools/*.mjs tools/lib/*.mjs forge.config.ts playwright.config.ts vite.*.config.ts vitest.config.ts tools/eslint package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check app test/electron test/e2e test/support/fake-companion.mjs test/project/*.test.mjs tools/*.mjs tools/lib/*.mjs forge.config.ts playwright.config.ts vite.*.config.ts vitest.config.ts tools/eslint package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.test: pnpm run test:project && pnpm run test:native && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:companion
scripts.test:native: cmake -S . -B build/native -G Ninja -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build/native && ctest --test-dir build/native --output-on-failure
scripts.test:coverage:native: cmake -S . -B build/coverage -G Ninja -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=x86_64-conda-linux-gnu-g++ -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS='--coverage -O0 -g' -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS=--coverage && cmake --build build/coverage --target clean && cmake --build build/coverage && ctest --test-dir build/coverage --output-on-failure && mkdir -p coverage/native && gcovr --gcov-executable x86_64-conda-linux-gnu-gcov --root . --filter '^core/' --filter '^src/' --exclude '^core/netft/test/' --xml-pretty --output coverage/native/coverage.xml build/coverage
